headlines.text: Back on this day in 2024, The Young Bucks vs. Fletcher & Ospreay clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.43 ? a fantastic contest. Fletcher & Ospreay was challenging for gold for the very first time. Fletcher's dive-back interference helped Ospreay and the Young Bucks survive a TK Driver spot, with the Bucks retaining their tag titles over Ospreay and Fletcher in a Match of the Year contender.

On a Wednesday in 2024, back when Hook vs. Roderick Strong fought tooth and nail for the FTW Title in a FTW Rules match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.54. It was the 20th time the FTW Title had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Rewind to 2024, when Jon Moxley vs. Darby Allin met in a Number One Contender, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle, on an outstanding Grand Slam '24 - Night 1 show that earned an overall rating of 8.34.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2024, when the AEW Women's World Title was up for grabs as Mariah May vs. Yuka Sakazaki went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.75. For Yuka Sakazaki, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 60th match in AEW Women's World Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title.
It was 2024 when Bryan Danielson vs. Nigel McGuinness delivered an excellent showing on Dynamite, rated 8.06 ? part of a stacked Grand Slam '24 - Night 1 card, rated 8.34 overall.
